_comment: Edit freely. Add { text, status: 'todo' | 'done', owner?: '@handle' } items. Rendered on limen-dev only.

items.text: Add CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN repo secret (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions)
Set Cloudflare Registrar owner/contact email for telotia.com, telotia.ca, and telotia.ai to hello@telotia.com
Add telotia.com as an active Cloudflare zone for the limen production Worker custom domain
Deploy limen-dev to the Cloudflare workers.dev debug page
Add dev.telotia.com as the custom domain for the limen-dev debug page
Invite the two other programmers as Telotia/Limen collaborators
Replace the Coming-Soon page with the real site
